record.paper_title: 20 Open Questions About Deformations of Compactifiable Manifolds
record.original_question: Solve the completion problem from Question 15 for pseudoconcave complex manifolds X satisfying Proposition 40. Concretely, X should satisfy one of the following source-stated hypotheses: either dim X = n >= 3 and for every x in X there exists t > 0 and sections f1, ..., ft of the t-th tensor power of the canonical bundle ω_X that give local coordinates at x; or, for every x in X there exists t > 0 and sections f1, ..., fn of ω_X^⊗t giving local coordinates at x and, for every distinct x,y in X, some section of a tensor power of ω_X vanishes at x but not at y.

evidence.quote: Proposition 40. Let X be an n-dimensional pseudoconcave complex manifold. Assume that one of the following conditions is satisfied: (1) either n ≥ 3 and for each x ∈ X there exists an integer t > 0 and f1, . . . , ft ∈ ω⊗t_X giving local coordinates at x; or (2) for each x ∈ X there exists an integer t > 0 and f1, . . . , fn ∈ ω⊗t_X giving local coordinates of X at x and for all x, y ∈ X such that x ≠ y there exists m > 0 and f ∈ H0(ω⊗m_X) such that f(x) = 0 and f(y) ≠ 0.
Question 16. Solve question 15 for spaces X satisfying the properties in Proposition 40.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be an n-dimensional connected pseudoconcave complex manifold (i.e., X admits an exhaustion such that the set of points where the exhaustion is strictly plurisubharmonic from above contains a nonempty open subset, in the sense of Andreotti). Let ω_X denote the canonical line bundle of X. Assume that X satisfies at least one of the following two conditions:

(1) n ≥ 3, and for every x ∈ X there exists an integer t > 0 and global sections f_1, …, f_t ∈ H^0(X, ω_X^{⊗ t}) which give local holomorphic coordinates at x; or

(2) for every x ∈ X there exists an integer t > 0 and global sections f_1, …, f_n ∈ H^0(X, ω_X^{⊗ t}) which give local holomorphic coordinates at x, and in addition for every pair of distinct points x, y ∈ X there exist an integer m > 0 and a section f ∈ H^0(X, ω_X^{⊗ m}) with f(x) = 0 and f(y) ≠ 0.

Question: Does there exist a compact complex analytic space X̄ together with a holomorphic open embedding X ↪ X̄ realizing X as an open subset of X̄ (a "completion" of X)? Equivalently, can every such pseudoconcave manifold X be holomorphically completed to a compact complex space?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as one of twenty open questions about deformations and completions of compactifiable manifolds in a 2020 preprint. No subsequent work resolving the completion problem in this specific generality (under the canonical-bundle local-coordinate hypotheses) was located in available searches; related results (Andreotti, Rossi, projective embedding of pseudoconcave spaces) address adjacent but not identical formulations. Status appears open.

status_evidence.title: 20 open questions about deformations of compactifiable manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Introduces deformation notions for compactifiable manifolds and lists open questions on completion of pseudoconcave manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: The completion question for pseudoconcave manifolds satisfying canonical-bundle hypotheses is listed as open.

status_evidence.title: Projective embedding of pseudoconcave spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Classical results on embedding pseudoconcave spaces using sections of line bundles.
status_evidence.claim: Related embedding results exist but do not directly resolve the completion question in the stated form.
